title: ratchetwatch: missing audit constitution and CLAUDE.md
description: Ratchetwatch evidence (2026-10-01, commit 16e9a76d73bae69a034ed581eba3d73deb328fce): docs/CONSTITUTION.md and CLAUDE.md are absent from the repository, so Article II/Article VIII standards could not be cited and no project-specific ratchet policy could be verified. Repository scan found no coverage, file-size, bundle-size, or debt-marker budget files. The configured test equivalent ./bin/test could not run because bats is not installed (exit 127). Restore the governing documentation and ratchet configuration or explicitly document that this project has no ratchets.
